quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Since the restaurant began sourcing its seafood locally each morning rather than from a regional distributor, the menu now changes daily depending entirely on what the fishing boats happen to bring in.
quests.hint: Find what the restaurant used to source seafood from.
quests.explanation: The passage says a regional distributor, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Importantly, since the ride-hailing app's surge pricing algorithm was found to correlate with a rider's device battery level, a detail the company attributes to an unintended flaw, regulators in several regions have requested a formal explanation.
quests.hint: Find what type of pricing algorithm was investigated.
quests.explanation: The passage says surge pricing, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Since early identification of postpartum mood disorders significantly improves treatment outcomes, several hospital systems have begun screening new mothers at multiple points during the first year rather than relying on a single assessment before discharge.
quests.hint: Find what type of mood disorders benefit from early identification.
quests.explanation: The passage says postpartum mood disorders, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Since the theater's pay-what-you-can pricing model was introduced for a limited number of performances each run, early data suggests it has meaningfully broadened the age range of ticket buyers without significantly reducing overall revenue.
quests.hint: Find what pricing model the theater introduced.
quests.explanation: The passage says the pay-what-you-can model, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Incidentally, since permafrost in parts of the Arctic has begun thawing at an accelerated rate, scientists have discovered ancient plant and animal remains preserved for thousands of years suddenly becoming exposed and vulnerable to decomposition.
quests.hint: Find what has begun thawing at an accelerated rate.
quests.explanation: The passage says the permafrost, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Since local volunteers began offering free tax preparation assistance for low-income residents each spring, hundreds of families who previously paid for the service or missed filing deadlines entirely have been able to file accurately and on time.
quests.hint: Find what type of tax help volunteers now offer.
quests.explanation: The passage says tax preparation assistance, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Having tried and abandoned nearly a dozen different productivity apps over the years, Owen finally settled on a simple paper planner instead, admitting that the physical act of crossing off a finished task felt far more satisfying than any digital checkmark.
quests.hint: Find what Owen finally settled on instead of apps.
quests.explanation: The passage says a simple paper planner, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Admittedly, although most instructors initially resisted replacing traditional final exams with cumulative portfolios, several now argue the change has produced a far more accurate picture of what students actually retained over the semester.
quests.hint: Find what replaced traditional final exams.
quests.explanation: The passage says cumulative portfolios, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the firm's leadership had assured staff that the merger would barely affect daily operations, employees quickly found themselves navigating an unexpected patchwork of overlapping systems and duplicated approval processes.
quests.hint: Find what employees found themselves navigating.
quests.explanation: The passage says an unexpected patchwork, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the guidebook explicitly warned that the coastal trail becomes impassable after heavy rain due to flooding at the lower crossing, a group of hikers attempted it anyway and had to turn back when the crossing proved submerged.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the crossing when the hikers turned back.
quests.explanation: The passage says the crossing was submerged, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Revealingly, although Petra and her husband had assumed that fully combining their finances after marriage would simplify budgeting considerably, they discovered within the first year that a hybrid system reduced friction far more effectively than complete consolidation had.
quests.hint: Find what type of system reduced friction more effectively.
quests.explanation: The passage says a hybrid system, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the store's return policy technically allows exchanges within thirty days, employees are given some discretion to make exceptions for gifts that predictably arrive without the original receipt.
quests.hint: Find what employees are given regarding exceptions.
quests.explanation: The passage says some discretion, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although plant-based meat alternatives are often assumed to be automatically healthier simply by virtue of being plant-based, a nutritional comparison found many alternatives contained comparable or even higher sodium levels once seasoning was accounted for.
quests.hint: Find what nutrient the comparison focused on.
quests.explanation: The passage says sodium levels, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Unsurprisingly, although cloud-based photo storage is often assumed to guarantee permanent preservation of uploaded images, an investigation into several providers' terms of service found that inactive accounts could have their content deleted after a defined period.
quests.hint: Find what type of accounts could have content deleted.
quests.explanation: The passage says inactive accounts, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although chronic pain is often assumed to be strictly proportional to measurable tissue damage, a growing body of research in pain science has demonstrated that psychological factors can significantly amplify or dampen its subjective intensity.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the assumed relationship to tissue damage.
quests.explanation: The passage says strictly proportional, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the beloved author had announced her retirement from writing nearly five years ago, fan speculation intensified after a small publishing house recently confirmed an entirely new manuscript would be released next year.
quests.hint: Find what was recently confirmed for release next year.
quests.explanation: The passage says a new manuscript, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Notably, although wolves are often portrayed in popular stories as solitary hunters, they are in fact highly social animals that typically live and hunt in coordinated family groups called packs, with lone wolves occurring only temporarily.
quests.hint: Find what the coordinated family groups are called.
quests.explanation: The passage says they are called packs, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the town council's public commitment to transparency suggested otherwise, several residents who requested detailed budget documents through official channels reported waiting months for any response at all.
quests.hint: Find what the council publicly committed to.
quests.explanation: The passage says transparency, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because her downstairs neighbors work opposite overnight shifts, Priya has learned to time her loudest household chores, like vacuuming, for the narrow midday window when both of them happen to be awake at the same time.
quests.hint: Find what loud chore Priya times carefully.
quests.explanation: The passage says vacuuming, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Interestingly, before the scholarship committee reviews any application, a preliminary screening removes submissions missing even a single required document, a strict policy that has frustrated some otherwise strong applicants who overlooked a minor formatting requirement.
quests.hint: Find what removes incomplete submissions before review.
quests.explanation: The passage says a preliminary screening, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Before the annual budget review begins, each department must submit a detailed justification for any line item that increased by more than a modest, predetermined percentage from the previous year.
quests.hint: Find what each department must submit for large increases.
quests.explanation: The passage says a detailed justification, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Before finalizing any non-refundable booking near the volcanic region, travelers are advised to check current ash advisories, since even minor eruptions can disrupt flight schedules for days at a time.
quests.hint: Find what travelers are advised to check.
quests.explanation: The passage says ash advisories, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Tellingly, before Farid's grandparents agreed to move into a smaller home closer to his family, months of gentle persuasion were needed to overcome their reluctance to leave the house they had lived in for four decades.
quests.hint: Find what was needed to overcome their reluctance.
quests.explanation: The passage says months of persuasion, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Before the seasonal clearance event begins, most of the deeply discounted merchandise is quietly moved to a separate section, leaving regular shoppers to wonder why so little inventory remains once the sale officially starts.
quests.hint: Find what is quietly moved to a separate section.
quests.explanation: The passage says the discounted merchandise, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Before the bakery's slow fermentation process, which takes nearly two full days, was widely known, most customers assumed the higher price simply reflected fancier packaging rather than a genuinely different method.
quests.hint: Find what process the bakery uses that takes two days.
quests.explanation: The passage says the fermentation process, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Strikingly, before the budget tablet's processor struggles with multitasking became widely known through reviews, the manufacturer's marketing had implied the device was equally suitable for both casual entertainment and serious productivity work.
quests.hint: Find what the processor struggled with, according to reviews.
quests.explanation: The passage says multitasking, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Before the clinic began offering evening appointments specifically for patients who work during the day, those time slots simply did not exist, forcing many working adults to either miss appointments or take unpaid time off.
quests.hint: Find what type of time off working adults had to take.
quests.explanation: The passage says unpaid time off, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Before the museum's blockbuster exhibit opened to record crowds, curators had privately worried that a smaller, less accessible companion exhibit down the hall would be almost entirely overlooked by comparison.
quests.hint: Find who had privately worried about the companion exhibit.
quests.explanation: The passage says the curators worried, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Curiously, before coral bleaching events became noticeably more frequent and severe in recent decades, marine biologists rarely needed to selectively breed heat-resistant coral fragments as a deliberate conservation strategy.
quests.hint: Find what events became more frequent and severe.
quests.explanation: The passage says coral bleaching events, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Before the participatory budgeting pilot launched, city officials had seen only mixed results from similar programs elsewhere, yet they allocated a modest portion of the discretionary budget anyway to evaluate its effectiveness locally.
quests.hint: Find what type of budget portion officials allocated.
quests.explanation: The passage says the discretionary budget, so that is correct.
